A <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c> that takes the {{opponent}}'s <c:ffff00>attack<c> after
bracing to reduce <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> as much as possible.

The higher the <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> stat of the <c:ffff00>legs<c>,
the more the <c:ffff00>Defense Power<c> rises temporarily.

The {{damage}} taken is reduced by the increased
Defense Power.
